# xdesk's keys

<!-- Generated from `xdesk --keys-markdown en`; do not edit by hand. The keys test rewrites it with XDESK_KEYS_WRITE=1. -->

Super alone: the applications. Super held a second: the keys used most.

| Group | Action | Keys |
|---|---|---|
| Find | Applications | `Super+Space` |
|  | Applications, the most recent first | `Super+Tab`, `Super+Shift+Tab` |
|  | The application's other windows | `` Super+` ``, `` Super+Shift+` `` |
|  | The windows, where they are | `Alt+Tab`, `Alt+Shift+Tab` |
|  | Overview | `Super+O` |
| Focus and move | Focus left | `Super+Left`, `Super+H` |
|  | Focus right | `Super+Right`, `Super+L` |
|  | Focus up | `Super+Up`, `Super+K` |
|  | Focus down | `Super+Down`, `Super+J` |
|  | Move left (stacked: left half) | `Super+Shift+Left`, `Super+Shift+H` |
|  | Move right (stacked: right half) | `Super+Shift+Right`, `Super+Shift+L` |
|  | Move up (stacked: top, the whole) | `Super+Shift+Up`, `Super+Shift+K` |
|  | Move down (stacked: bottom, back) | `Super+Shift+Down`, `Super+Shift+J` |
|  | Into the column (group) on the left | `Super+[` |
|  | Out to a column of its own | `Super+]` |
| Windows | Maximize, or restore | `Super+F` |
|  | Full screen, or back | `Super+Shift+F` |
|  | Float, or put back | `Super+Shift+Space` |
|  | Always on top | `Super+P` |
|  | On every workspace | `Super+Shift+P` |
|  | Close the window | `Super+Q`, `Alt+F4` |
| Size | Column width: 1/3, 1/2, 2/3, all | `Super+R` |
|  | Height in the column: equal, 2/3, 1/3 | `Super+Shift+R` |
|  | Narrower (canvas: zoom out) | `Super+-` |
|  | Wider (canvas: zoom in) | `Super+=`, `Super+Shift+Plus` |
|  | Equal widths (canvas: 100 %, the focused window in the middle) | `Super+0` |
| Arrangements | Tile, stack, canvas | `Super+M` |
| Workspaces | Workspace 1 | `Super+1` |
|  | Workspace 2 | `Super+2` |
|  | Workspace 3 | `Super+3` |
|  | Workspace 4 | `Super+4` |
|  | Workspace 5 | `Super+5` |
|  | Workspace 6 | `Super+6` |
|  | Workspace 7 | `Super+7` |
|  | Workspace 8 | `Super+8` |
|  | Workspace 9 | `Super+9` |
|  | To workspace 1 | `Super+Shift+1` |
|  | To workspace 2 | `Super+Shift+2` |
|  | To workspace 3 | `Super+Shift+3` |
|  | To workspace 4 | `Super+Shift+4` |
|  | To workspace 5 | `Super+Shift+5` |
|  | To workspace 6 | `Super+Shift+6` |
|  | To workspace 7 | `Super+Shift+7` |
|  | To workspace 8 | `Super+Shift+8` |
|  | To workspace 9 | `Super+Shift+9` |
|  | The workspace before | `Super+Ctrl+Left`, `Super+PageUp` |
|  | The workspace after | `Super+Ctrl+Right`, `Super+PageDown` |
|  | To the workspace before, with the window | `Super+Ctrl+Shift+Left`, `Super+Shift+PageUp` |
|  | To the workspace after, with the window | `Super+Ctrl+Shift+Right`, `Super+Shift+PageDown` |
| Open | Terminal | `Super+Enter`, `Ctrl+Alt+T` |
|  | Settings | `Super+I` |
|  | These keys | `Super+/` |
